versions.changelog: Re-publish: 0.4.2 artifact was built seconds before skill-card.md was written, so the card was missing from the bundle. No code changes vs 0.4.2 (heavy-mode ticker scoping + offline demo).

Heavy mode is now ticker-scoped: answers come only from documents labeled with the requested ticker; refuses to answer when the index has no docs for that ticker instead of presenting other companies' filings. Re-bundle skill-card.md (missing from 0.4.1 artifact).

--demo now strictly offline: forces retrieval-only and never calls an LLM even if an API key is set (no external request from the demo path). Builds on 0.4.0 section-aware retrieval + pure-Python BM25.

Section-aware chunking+ranking (MD&A/Outlook/FLS boost, table down-weight, guidance-synonym expansion) — recall 0/3→3/3 on AAPL 10-Q; dropped rank_bm25 (pure-Python BM25); new --demo for zero-network/key/dep first run.

Foreign private issuers via --form auto (10-Q→10-K→20-F→40-F→6-K), retrieval recall check with loud low-coverage warning, quoted source citations, graceful no-API-key degradation (retrieval-only), EDGAR retry/backoff, --json structured output, documented boundaries (When NOT to invoke).
Self-contained light mode: no ES/Ollama needed. Auto-detects heavy mode if SEC_PIPELINE_DIR is set. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY.
Initial release: SEC guidance extraction via local RAG
